prompt:
Goal: Create a premium cinematic bridal fashion collage featuring a young South Asian woman as the main subject, with a dreamy luxury editorial aesthetic.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 portrait composition, soft ivory-white background, high-resolution fashion poster look, elegant and romantic.

Layout: Use a multi-layer collage. Place one enormous grayscale close-up portrait of the woman’s face in the background on the left, softly faded and occupying most of the canvas height. In front, center the same woman in full color as a full-body fashion portrait, standing slightly turned forward with calm direct eye contact and a gentle smile. Add a right-side vertical strip of exactly 5 rectangular detail panels, evenly spaced with thin white borders: 1 close-up of one eye and cheek with hair, 2 close-up of wavy auburn hair decorated with small flowers, 3 close-up of a monarch butterfly on white blossoms, 4 close-up of delicate white wildflowers and branches, 5 close-up of the red embroidered blouse and gold floral fabric details.

Subject details: The woman has warm auburn-brown wavy hair, natural makeup, defined brows, soft pink lips, and realistic skin texture. She wears a deep red saree with sheer drape, ornate gold embroidered borders, small gold floral motifs, and a richly embellished sleeveless blouse. Add traditional gold jhumka earrings, stacked gold bangles, and subtle rings. Her pose is elegant and modest, one arm relaxed downward and the other hand resting lightly near the forearm, with the saree drape flowing vertically.

Decorative elements: Add exactly 6 visible monarch butterflies: 1 large butterfly at the lower left foreground, 1 small butterfly near the upper center, 1 medium butterfly near the upper right of the central subject, 1 small butterfly near the middle-right beside the saree, 1 large butterfly inside the third right-side detail panel, and 1 small pale butterfly silhouette near the top-right background. Surround the portrait with delicate white blossoms, baby’s-breath branches, petals, soft bokeh sparkles, and misty light leaks, especially along the woman’s hair and the lower background.

Visual style: Premium cinematic fashion photo-effect, realistic portrait photography blended with editorial collage design, shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio lighting, warm highlights on the red saree, monochrome background face, full-color foreground subject, ethereal floral atmosphere, crisp fabric embroidery, elegant Indian bridal styling.

Constraints: Preserve realistic facial proportions and natural body shape. Do not add text, logos, watermarks, extra people, extra panels, or additional butterflies. Keep the design clean, high-fashion, romantic, and luxurious.
